consent.title: Your data, your choice
consent.collect: Your phone number, your profile, the money entries you add, your chats with Saathi and scam messages you check. Voice recordings are turned into text and then deleted.
consent.purpose: To give you money guidance, find schemes for you, and keep you safe from scams.
consent.retention: Until you delete it. You can delete your chats, memories or your whole account any time.
consent.rights: You can see, correct, download or delete your data, and raise a complaint.
